root_idea.summary: The root has two principal semantic axes: liquid or moisture, especially a clear drop or fluid, and ornament, especially pearls or pearl ornaments.
root_idea.development: The liquid axis extends to seminal fluid, dripping or flowing liquids, rain lasting through the night, and sweat; figurative extensions include soiling, blemish, and spoilage. The other axis concerns pearls and earrings.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Classical Arabic singular citation form نُطْفَة.

senses.definition: A drop or small quantity of seminal fluid.
senses.usage_conditions: In Quranic creation passages, the noun denotes the reproductive fluid from which a human being develops; the lexical description includes fluid from a man or woman.

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader liquid sense of the noun, distinct from its Quranic reproductive-fluid use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A pearl; collectively, pearls, including a pearl ornament worn in the ear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: نَطَفٌ may refer collectively to pearls, while نُطْفَةٌ denotes one pearl.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A rainy night during which rain continues until morning.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional description of a night marked by continuous rain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Something liquid that drips or flows.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The flowing-liquid sense is extended idiomatically in مَنْطِفُ المعروف, describing beneficence as flowing from a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A kind of sweetmeat, identified with قُبَّيْطَى.
Soiled, blemished, or defective; to become spoiled.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The adjectival use is especially associated with ugliness or defect. The related idiom يَنْطِفُ بسوء describes associating or besmirching someone with evil.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Pointer-only reference to an earrings discussion; its lexical branch is independently covered elsewhere.
The seminal-fluid meaning is represented by the Quranic noun sense.
The sweetmeat meaning is represented under نَاطِف.

cautions: The Quranic occurrences in this packet support the seminal-fluid sense; the clear-water, pearl, rain, sweat, flowing-liquid, and blemish meanings are broader Classical Arabic usages.
